title: Follow an opened link to the browser window, never an open web app
head: 308f33530d8a
workflow: Early pipeline: one or two Claude technical reviewers, coordinator synthesis, editorial check
outcome: No actionable findings. Synthetic integration verifies URL-web-app exclusion and focus-before-launch ordering.
limits: No live browser/compositor tab reuse, workspace placement or focus-event timing tested. Installed PWA identities not universally covered. Two Node-dependent related tests stopped at dependency setup.
retro:
# Retrospective

## What worked

Fresh verified Fable High and Astra Xhigh sessions independently built separate fixtures and reached the same narrow conclusion. Actual launcher/helper integration plus mutation controls made selection and ordering claims substantially stronger than literal regex assertions alone. Both isolated evidence bundles sealed successfully. No desktop resources were needed for this scope.

## Friction and improvements

Fable's clipboard and captive-portal test attempts stopped because Node was absent from the sandbox PATH. This is a known tool-exposure limitation, not a new tooling defect or PR failure. Explicitly stage a hashed standalone Node binary when those tests materially exercise the changed code; here they mock the launcher, so further setup offered little value.

Source research helps explain Chromium behavior but cannot replace compositor/browser observation or prove focus-event synchronization. Preserve that distinction in positive reviews. Differing synthetic installed-PWA classes were not allowed to become an asserted real-world defect.

## Tooling and resources

No confirmed Omadev issue, desktop slot usage, host mutation or leftover runtime. The coordinator used only role-specific fresh starts, leaving its own session intact. Reviewer panes and historical evidence remain preserved. Editorial verification runs in a fresh single-input Astra Medium session; the outer assistant handles publication and the eventual batch overview.
comment:
**Verified:** No actionable issue found in the inspected and tested scope at `308f33530d8a`. The launcher excludes the tested URL-derived web-app classes and attempts browser focus before submitting the URL launch.

With synthetic clients listed as `chromium-chat.example.com__-Default` followed by `chromium`, the actual launcher and focus helper recorded:

```text
Baseline: launch URL -> focus dispatch to web app
PR head:  focus dispatch to tabbed browser -> launch URL
```

These are recorded calls to mocked desktop and launch commands, not observed browser window transitions. With only the URL web app present, the head launches without dispatching focus to it. No-URL and private-only invocations still skip focus; failed focus dispatches do not prevent launching.

**Verified:** The launcher, focus-helper, browser-environment and command-style tests pass on both revisions. The head launcher test rejects the baseline launcher; separately restoring the old launch-before-focus order fails the ordering assertion.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Real shell scripts and jq with synthetic client lists and mocked browser, desktop and process-launch boundaries. Live tab reuse, workspace placement and browser focus-event timing were not tested. The selection result is scoped to URL-derived web-app identities, not every installed PWA.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra initial inspection, independent Fable 5.1 and separate Astra reviews, followed by verification of the reported claims against source and targeted test evidence.
